home.videoSectionSubtitle: See before and after footage of homes renovated right here in the Coachella Valley.

kitchen.title: Kitchen Remodeling
kitchen.subtitle: Custom culinary spaces tailored for beauty, function, and entertaining.
kitchen.description: Upgrade your kitchen with custom cabinetry, quartz and granite countertops, island extensions, designer backsplashes, and high-efficiency lighting.
highlights: Custom solid-wood cabinetry & soft-close systems
Granite, Quartz & Marble countertop fabrication
Open concept layout removals & load-bearing beam work
Under-cabinet LED lighting & pendant fixture installation

bathroom.title: Bathroom Remodeling
bathroom.subtitle: Convert outdated bathrooms into relaxing, spa-grade retreats.
bathroom.description: Walk-in curbless showers, freestanding soaking tubs, floating vanities, custom tile patterns, and water-efficient luxury fixtures.
highlights: Curbless walk-in showers & custom glass enclosures
High-end freestanding soak tubs & thermostatic valves
Heated tile flooring & waterproof Schluter systems
Dual floating quartz vanities & smart LED mirrors

cabinetry.title: Custom Cabinetry
cabinetry.subtitle: Handcrafted kitchen, vanity, and pantry cabinets built to last.
cabinetry.description: Choose from Shaker, Flat Panel Modern, or Traditional raised panel styles in premium hardwoods with durable factory finishes.
highlights: 100% solid wood face frames & dovetail drawer boxes
Soft-close Blum hardware standard on all doors & drawers
Custom pull-out pantries, spice racks & trash organizers
Factory baked-on polyurethane finish for desert heat durability

countertops.title: Countertop Fabrication & Installation
countertops.subtitle: Durable, stain-resistant Quartz, Granite, and Quartzite surfaces.
countertops.description: Precision CNC fabrication and laser-templated installation ensuring seamless joins and flawless edge profiles.
highlights: Laser digital templating for 1/16th inch accuracy
Mitred waterfall edge profiles and custom bevels
Stain & heat resistant high-performance sealing
Undermount sink cutouts and integrated drain boards

flooring.title: Luxury Flooring Installation
flooring.subtitle: Waterproof luxury vinyl plank (LVP), large-format porcelain tile, and hardwood.
flooring.description: Premium flooring solutions engineered to withstand desert sunlight, temperature fluctuations, and heavy foot traffic.
highlights: 100% waterproof luxury vinyl plank (LVP) with scratch guard
Modern large-format porcelain & rectified ceramic tile
Subfloor leveling and crack-isolation membrane prep
Flush transitions and matching baseboard trim upgrades
